command: graph.import(file); new Sigma(graph, <div 1200x900>) with sigma's default settings; toBlob(sigma, { format: "png" })
how: sigma 4 draws nodes, edges and labels with WebGL2 and offers no vector export. @sigma/export-image's toBlob renders the instance to PNG (its own export, 1200 x 900, transparent background); the SVG wraps those bytes unmodified in one <image> element.

canvas.background: none (the page behind it is white)

determinism: Math.random seeded (mulberry32, seed 1) and Date.now stopped at 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z before the library loads; pinned fonts (visual-fonts/fonts.conf); nothing removed from the SVG
png: tools/rasterize.mjs (resvg-js 2.6.2, over white, fonts from visual-fonts/fonts)
